caseNameFull: Smith v. Industrial Accident Commission of California
attorneys: Petitioner pro se. Everett A. Corten for respondent Workmen’s Compensation Appeals Board.

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion to dispense with printing petition, and motion of respondent Workmen’s Compensation Appeals Board (formerly Industrial Accident Commission) to dispense with printing its brief, granted. Certiorari denied.
